NVLink-C2C link is a separate physical path from HBM3e. If the two paths

## 1. Rebuild static owner map against expected activation cost

### Verdict: Viable

The order-statistic skew you describe (86% of the cross-rank max is the tail of
the distribution, not persistent imbalance) means a static reassignment that
minimises the *expected* per-rank activation cost can shave the tail. The key
insight is that the per-layer span is `max over ranks`, so you want to minimise
the expected maximum, not the expected sum.
